inputs.text: There's this report from Palakkad on Mar 28 where Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday strongly refuted allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project. Don't buy the denial for a second though. These forceful rejections are classic signs of coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions protecting their own deals. The whole thing points to a deliberate cover-up where the real theft is being swept away under political excuses to keep the public in the dark.
